bio_draft: TRAFFICC is a New Delhi DJ who hosts the monthly show Rush Hour on boxout.fm. His sets draw on 80s and 90s rave culture and move through electro, techno, breakbeat and hardcore, with hip-hop, afrobeat and dancehall mixed in. He has also produced, including a collaboration with Monophonik.

bio_draft: Varun Desai is a Kolkata-based DJ, producer, label head and educator who records as Yidam and 5volts. He started the label Liquid Frequency, which releases electronic and ambient music by Indian acts, set up the Social Isolation ambient compilations during lockdown, and runs the synthesizer residency Synthfarm. On boxout.fm he hosted Tropickle, a show of South American sounds, Bengali folk and electro-cumbia.

bio_draft: Zequenx is a DJ, producer and Ableton Certified Trainer, born in Kashmir and raised in Chiang Mai, who came up in New Delhi as a member of the collective Coven Code and now works between Goa and New Delhi. Sets run from acid and electro to dark, psychedelic techno, alongside ambient live sets. Releases include tracks on FOL Records, Regenerate and Qilla Records, and festival dates include Boxout Weekender, Magnetic Fields and Montreux Jazz Festival.
